candidates: When suppressing ESLint warnings with `// eslint-disable` comments, disable only the specific rule(s) responsible (e.g., `// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any`) rather than using blanket suppressions that silence all rules for a line or block.
